subject: health
concept: Reflecting on personal health values and what wellness genuinely means to the individual student
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 health sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews the wellness areas studied across all grades and identifies which matter most to them personally
exercise.abstract: Student writes a personal statement on what wellness genuinely means to them, referencing concepts from across the sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: statement genuinely references at least two concepts from across different grade levels of the sequence
misconception_flags: statement is generic and doesn't reference any specific concept actually learned in the curriculum

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
